jobs.title: Managing Director - Capital Advisory
jobs.description:
About Vortex Capital:

Vortex Capital is a boutique capital advisory firm with a strong track record and extensive capabilities, having advised on over 500 billion in transaction volume across our team members & advisors. With a presence in major global hubs, including Zurich, London, New York, Miami, and Vancouver, we deliver value for clients across the early to middle market.

We’re hiring an MD focused on the capital raising and M&A side of our team. We have top-tier deal flow and no shortage of mandates / opportunities to raise for.

Position Overview

The MD will be responsible for leading capital-raising and select sell-side M&A transactions, engaging investors, speaking with clients, and driving successful deal closures. This is a senior role within the firm, working closely with other team members, clients, and investors to ensure seamless execution. Success in this position is measured by the ability to drive transactions to completion, secure investor commitments, and enhance the firm’s market position through exceptional execution and select origination.

Qualifications & Experience:

Licensed under FINRA
Experience raising $10M–$200M+ tickets for sectors like biotech, AI, infrastructure, technology, industrials, or other specialised industries
Proven track record raising from family offices, HNWIs, VCs, and growth equity investors for private companies
7+ years in IB, PE, or VC
Deep investor relationships and strong execution capabilities

Benefits:
Work alongside a top-tier global team of finance professionals with deep sector expertise
Fast growth trajectory with potential to move into partner-level roles quickly
Access to extremely strong deal flow
High earning potential with uncapped high upside tied to deal success

jobs.title: Director of Development
jobs.description:
Join Our Leadership Team

Therapists Beyond Borders is seeking an energetic, motivated Director of Development to propel our fundraising efforts and expand our capacity to serve communities through sustainable, locally led therapy programs.

‍

Director Of Development Responsibilities

Establish fundraising objectives for the organization, setting one year, five year, and longer-term goals.
Develop and implement a comprehensive fundraising plan to meet the organization’s annual revenue goals.
Work closely with the Board of Directors and Executive Director
Collaborate with the Director of Communications, Social Media Manager, Ambassador Program Manager, and Passport to Potential Program Manager regarding fundraising initiatives
Supervise Grants Coordinator to search potential sources of, and apply for, grants and public funding.
Identify and cultivate major gift prospects and individual donors, as well as corporate and foundation donors.
Plan and execute fundraising events that engage donors and effectively communicate the purposes of the organization
Monitor and analyze fundraising data to evaluate performance and adjust strategies as needed.

‍

Director Of Development Qualifications (Required)

Must be based in the USA
Demonstrate high-levels of transparency and fiduciary responsibility
Demonstrate a history of successful program advancement
Extensive knowledge of fundraising strategies and principles.
Excellent management and supervisory skills.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Excellent interpersonal skills.
Deep commitment to the organization’s mission and values
Strategic thinking and problem-solving skills
Demonstrate creativity, innovation, flexibility, and adaptability
Knowledge of tax planning principles and techniques that favor charitable giving.
Proficient in Google Workspace
Minimum 7-10 hours per week (ideally more)
Minimum commitment of one year (ideally more long-term)

‍

jobs.title: Director of Operations - State Farm Agent Team Member
jobs.description:
Benefits

Opportunity for advancement
Paid time off
Training & development
401(k)
Bonus based on performance
Competitive salary

You May Be a Great Fit as a Director of Operations at Misty Stathos - State Farm Agent if:

You’re the person people call first when life goes sideways — calm, steady, and ready to help.
You genuinely care about your community and want to make a positive impact on the people around you.
You’re detail-oriented, especially when handling sensitive information or important matters.
You listen first, then guide, making customers feel understood while confidently providing options.
You’re motivated by goals and growth, and you know how to turn needs-based conversations into confident customer decisions that truly help customers.

Location Address:
Lexington, SC 29072

At Misty Stathos - State Farm Agent, we’re here to help people protect what matters most. We take pride in serving our community with integrity, care, and real support. Whether we’re helping someone navigate a claim or personalize a plan, we believe in doing meaningful work that makes a difference. If you're looking to grow your career, help others, and be part of a team that strives to do good every day, you’ll fit right in with us .

A Director of Operations
leads business operations, coordinates team performance, and enhances overall efficiency. The role requires strong leadership and a proactive approach to office management.

Key Responsibilities

Lead daily operations and guide team workflow.
Oversee administrative and compliance procedures.
Track progress toward established business objectives.
Collaborate with the agent to implement strategic initiatives.
Promote a positive and customer-focused environment.

Qualifications

Leadership experience in business or office management.
Excellent communication and problem-solving skills.
Strong attention to detail and follow-through.
Ability to obtain state insurance licenses.

As Director of Operations for Misty Stathos - State Farm Agent, you run the day-to-day of a fast-moving State Farm agency and help the owner scale results. You lead the team, tighten processes, keep the agency compliant, and make sure every client gets fast, accurate help. You’ll own production rhythm, service standards, and the systems that drive retention and growth.

Responsibilities

People and Leadership

Recruit, hire, and onboard team members in sales and service roles
Set clear goals, run 1:1s, coach to metrics, and manage schedules
Build a positive, accountable culture focused on client outcomes

Sales Enablement and Growth

Run the weekly production cadence and pipeline reviews
Improve quote quality, follow-up, and close rates across P&C, Life, and Health
Partner with the owner on campaigns, referrals, reviews, and local events

Client Experience And Retention

Set service SLAs for calls, emails, and chats
Oversee renewals, coverage reviews, cross-sell, and claims triage
Track NPS or review scores and resolve escalations

Operations and Process

Document and improve SOPs for quoting, underwriting submissions, endorsements, billing, and renewals
Manage task queues, quality checks, and workload balancing
Keep data clean across CRM, phones, and e-sign tools

Ready to Launch Your Career?

We are a very busy office and are looking for our next great team member. We are an established, growth-oriented agency with a team of highly motivated individuals. We attribute our success to having a fun, energetic environment that is an enjoyable place to work. We take pride in using our years of valuable experience to mentor individual team members and prepare them for successful careers. If you want to work in an environment that is fun, challenging, and rewarding, then Misty Stathos - State Farm Agent may be the right fit for you! If you believe in having fun in a stable working environment and have a willingness to learn, we should meet to discuss our career opportunity.

About Our Agency

Our mission is to help people manage the risks of everyday life, recover from the unexpected and realize their dreams.
Our office is located in Lexington, SC.
Our office is open 9 am- 5 pm Monday through Friday (after hours by appointment).
I have been a State Farm agent since 2009.
Before becoming a State Farm Agent, I was previously employed as a State Farm Employee.
I am a second generation State Farm agent.
We currently have 5 team members at our agency.

We look forward to speaking with you!

State Farm agents are independent contractors who hire their own employees. State Farm agents’ employees are not employees of State Farm. Agents are responsible for and make all employment decisions regarding their employees.
